description: Structure of the theyos <-> consumer-repo source boundary. This file holds
STRUCTURE ONLY: discovered UniFFI surfaces, explicit surface-to-target
bindings, consumer targets, and the spelling of each immutable pin.
POLICY for pin age lives in scripts/check-cross-repo-pin-freshness.py.
The surfaces list is not trusted as complete. The gate re-derives UniFFI
surfaces from the tree and requires exact equality. Every discovered surface
then has exactly one binding state: active against one named consumer target,
or deferred through an owned, reasoned, expiring decision. The gate never
infers that every consumer manifest consumes every discovered surface.

binding.reason: No current consumer target builds this crate. RelayStreamGuestFFI deliberately implements a separate household-rs RelayStream/Noise boundary; adding an unused claw-share-bridge-rs dependency would satisfy the old predicate without creating a real consumer.
